description: What the plan-mode suite must notice (P9 ac-9, docs/PLAN-MODE.md): the gate's per-task plan policy weakened, moved behind Full Access or keyed wrongly; the plan approval clearing the policy on anything but an approval; decide() taking feedback or an edited plan where it must not; the runner not holding the policy, offering or running the spawn tools, reading MCP prompts, or forgetting the approval; and the routes and transports that carry planMode and the answer.

mutations.name: G1
mutations.what: the plan check is removed from authorize()

mutations.name: G2
mutations.what: the plan check comes after the Full Access shortcut

patches.old: // Full Access stays outside the workspace checks even for the operations it still asks about.
patches.new:
if(planned!==null)return this.#refuse(name,args,verdict,taskId,'policy',planned);
    // Full Access stays outside the workspace checks even for the operations it still asks about.

mutations.name: G3
mutations.what: any name counts as one of the Hub's own tools (a local.* name that no tool has, read by its name)

mutations.name: G4
mutations.what: a command that reads runs in plan mode

mutations.name: G5
mutations.what: only dangerous calls are refused in plan mode

mutations.name: G6
mutations.what: a checkpoint call (update_plan, studio.plan_set) is refused in plan mode

mutations.name: G7
mutations.what: one plan-mode task holds every task of the gate

mutations.name: G8
mutations.what: a policy that only looks like planOnly holds the task

mutations.name: G9
mutations.what: an approval does not clear the policy

mutations.name: G10
mutations.what: a denial or an expiry clears the policy

mutations.name: G11
mutations.what: an edited plan is taken with a denial

mutations.name: G12
mutations.what: feedback is taken for an ordinary approval request

mutations.name: G13
mutations.what: feedback of any length

mutations.name: G14
mutations.what: a plan approval is raised for a task that is not in plan mode

mutations.name: G15
mutations.what: a plan approval is held where nobody can answer it

mutations.name: R1
mutations.what: the spawn tools are offered to a plan-mode run

mutations.name: R2
mutations.what: dispatch runs spawn_agent / spawn_workflow for a plan-mode task (and they are offered)

mutations.name: R3
mutations.what: dispatch drops its own refusal of the spawn tools (they are still not offered)

mutations.name: R4
mutations.what: exit_plan_mode and the plan-mode instructions are not given to the model

mutations.name: R5
mutations.what: a plan-mode run does not hold its task on the gate

mutations.name: R6
mutations.what: a Hub that loads a plan-mode task does not hold it

mutations.name: R7
mutations.what: an approved plan is forgotten (planOnly ignores planApproval)

mutations.name: R8
mutations.what: a follow-up with planMode:false leaves plan mode

mutations.name: R9
mutations.what: MCP prompts and resources are read in plan mode

mutations.name: R10
mutations.what: the approved plan is not injected as a user message

mutations.name: R11
mutations.what: planApproval is not recorded on an approval

mutations.name: R12
mutations.what: a message switches a running ordinary task to plan mode silently (the check that it does not leave plan mode stays)

mutations.name: C1
mutations.what: the pool drops planMode for the primary runner

mutations.name: C2
mutations.what: a plan-mode conversation that runs as a second chat starts as an ordinary task

mutations.name: C3
mutations.what: the pool drops the feedback of an answer to a second chat's request

mutations.name: H1
mutations.what: the decide route drops the feedback of an answer

mutations.name: B1
mutations.what: the Browser Companion ignores planMode

patches.old: if (planMode !== undefined && planMode !== null && planMode !== false)

mutations.name: D1
mutations.what: a plan-mode API task is carried to the Companion
